cards.title: Childbirth Culture Needs to Evolve
cards.body: Healthcare professionals and parents share experiences about how society's expectations around 'ideal' childbirth can make people feel marginalized. Experts argue these cultural narratives need to shift to better support diverse birth experiences.

cards.title: Second Baby Parenting: What I Forgot
cards.body: After having a second child, a parent discovers they've forgotten crucial details about feeding, teething, and other basics from their first experience. Grandparent support and nostalgic reflection help navigate the learning curve again.

cards.title: Is AI Parenting Tech Actually Necessary?
cards.body: Tech companies increasingly market AI-powered parenting tools like eye-movement trackers and sleep optimizers to exhausted parents. The article questions whether these expensive solutions address real parenting needs or simply exploit parental anxiety.

cards.title: Rethinking the '18 Summers' Trend
cards.body: The viral '18 summers' parenting concept encourages parents to treat every school holiday as a memory-making opportunity. Critics argue this creates pressure and misses the point that unstructured downtime is valuable for children.

cards.title: ADHD Burnout in Children and Teens
cards.body: Children with ADHD can experience burnout that goes beyond typical ADHD symptoms, affecting motivation and emotional regulation. Parents should recognize these signs and learn supportive strategies to help their struggling child.

cards.title: Hidden Cost of Too Much Comfort
cards.body: While comforting struggling children feels natural, excessive comfort can prevent them from developing resilience. Children need space to work through discomfort to build emotional strength and coping skills.

cards.title: E-Scooter Injuries Rising in Young Children
cards.body: Children as young as nine are being treated for serious e-scooter crash injuries at UK trauma centers. Nearly 500 casualties under age 16 have been recorded at major hospitals, signaling growing safety concerns.
